title: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget
description: Influential Labour figures had been pushing for equalising CGT and income tax, but critics have said this could drive wealthy people out of Britain.

title: We asked teens what schools should teach them about work. This is what they said
description: Teenagers say they want more work experience at school and opportunities to improve their communication skills.

title: French cities calm overnight after curfews imposed to quell violence, PM says
description: Sébastien Lecornu said new curfews for Tuesday night would be decided where necessary.

title: Criminals detained in hospital set to lose benefits
description: The families of the victims of Nottingham killer Valdo Calocane had been campaigning for the change.

title: Burnham vows end to 'rip-off parking charges' under new rules
description: Penalties are seen as too harsh on motorists who are penalised for parking on private land.

title: US church on frontline of battle against drug known as 'tranq'
description: Synthetic opioids like fentanyl are more powerful and in plentiful supply, and they have transformed the drugs landscape.

title: Job vacancies fall as small firms cut back on recruitment
description: Small firms cite labour costs as a key factor in scaling back hiring, the Office for National Statistics says.

title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
description: Serhii Beskrestnov says there has not been enough time to warn people about incoming missile attacks. The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing.

title: Watch: Ukraine says it carried out first drone airlift of wounded soldier from front line
description: The serviceman was surrounded by landmines and enemy drones so a ground rescue was not possible, Ukraine's military says.
